text: The Chair of the Improving Access to Housing Working Group will provide an update and share the outcomes of the group's discussions.

The Housing Rights Advisory Committee recommended that: 1. The Executive Director, Housing Secretariat, invite the Co-operative Housing Federation of Toronto to provide a presentation at a meeting of the Housing Rights Advisory Committee in 2026 on how households access co-operative housing and how the supply can be increased to address the growing demand for safe, affordable, and adequate housing.
